title: Wellbeing Reminders
description: A mod that reminds you to take care of irl self while playing! (Reminders to hydrate, stretch, do wrist excersises, take breaks and sleep)
body:
# Wellbeing Reminders Remember to take care of yourself!
## Why? People need to be reminded to drink water on a hot day, stretch out a little etc. ## Description Wellbeing Reminders displays reminders via Minecraft's toasts; each one is configurable in Video Settings via Sodium API
Technically you can also edit `config\wbreminders.properties` but like, why? ### Reminders: - Hydrate Reminder - On by default - Reminds to hydrate so you.. well, don't dehydrate - Meal Reminder - Off by default - Reminds to take a break and eat something - Break Reminder - On by default - Reminds to take a break from playing - Sleep Reminder - Off by default - Reminds to go to sleep at a set hour - Stretch Reminder - Off by default - Reminds to stretch a little - Wrist Exercises Reminder - Off by default
## (Possibly) FAQ
Port to 1.20.1? No. Let it die. _Please._
Also Sodium doesn't have its API on 1.20.1
Port to Forge? HA, never!
